title: Page bridge operations
description: window.chessBridge: what the Godot game asks of the page.

entities.name: Ask the computer for a move
entities.description: Stockfish's move after the given moves, at strength 1–8.
entities.transport: window.chessBridge.bestMove(moves, level, done), called by Api.engine_move through JavaScriptBridge
entities.authorization: None: anything in the page may call it.
entities.result: done(uci) with Stockfish's bestmove, after at least the strength's pause (450 ms at strength 1, none at 7 and 8).
failures: The engine cannot start (no Web Worker, or the Worker reports an error): done("").
The search is cancelled, or another starts, before it answers: done is never called.

entities.name: Cancel the search
entities.description: Stops any search; its answer is thrown away.
entities.result: The current search, if any, is stopped with UCI stop and its bestmove ignored.

entities.name: Start the engine early
entities.description: Warms Stockfish up so the first move comes quickly.
entities.transport: window.chessBridge.preloadEngine(), called by Api.engine_preload on the set-up screen and a computer game
entities.result: The Web Worker is created and sent uci.
failures: The engine cannot start: nothing is said now; the next bestMove answers "".

entities.name: Take the invitation in the address
entities.description: The ?challenge=ID the page was opened with, once.
entities.transport: window.chessBridge.takeChallenge(), called by Api.challenge_in_address when the game starts
entities.result: The id (8 to 40 lowercase letters and digits), and the address without it; "" if there was none or it was already taken.
failures: An id of another shape is ignored: "".

entities.name: Leave for a sign-in page
entities.description: Sends the browser to an address, with where to come back to.
entities.transport: window.chessBridge.navigate(url), called by Api.sign_in with auth/login/{provider}?return= returnPath()
entities.result: The page is left; an invitation not yet taken survives in the return address.

relatedViews.relationship: The capability these operations belong to.
The feature the engine operations carry out.
The use cases that call them: playing the computer, and answering an invitation from its link.
